_readme: Dataset manifest. Every real-data event in the game must reference an id here. Update `verified` only after checking the primary source yourself.

datasets.name: DONKI solar flare, X8.7, 14 May 2024
datasets.source: NASA CCMC DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information)
datasets.instrument: GOES X-ray flux (flare classification as catalogued in DONKI)
datasets.location: Sun / Earth orbit. NOT measured at Mars.
datasets.transformation: Scheduled onto a mission Sol by the game. Class mapped to a simplified radiation multiplier (X=2.0, M=1.4, C=1.0).
datasets.limitations: DONKI does not measure radiation at the fictional outpost. The multiplier is a game model.
datasets.verifiedHow: DONKI web service FLR query for 2024-05-14 returned classType X8.7; NASA Science blog of 14 May 2024 confirms the peak time.

datasets.name: DONKI solar flare, X9.0, 3 Oct 2024
datasets.instrument: GOES X-ray flux (as catalogued in DONKI)
datasets.location: Sun / Earth orbit. NOT measured at Mars.
datasets.transformation: Episode 1 storm is modelled on this flare (class sets the alert peak: X = STORM). Campaign: scheduled onto a Sol with a simplified radiation multiplier.
datasets.limitations: DONKI does not measure radiation at the fictional outpost. The alert levels and health drain are a game model.
datasets.verifiedHow: DONKI web service FLR query for 2024-10-03 returned classType X9.0; NASA Science blog of 3 Oct 2024 confirms the peak time.

datasets.name: 2018 Mars global dust storm
datasets.source: NASA Mars exploration reporting (Opportunity rover mission)
datasets.transformation: Used as inspiration for the 'global dust storm' event. Game dust opacity is a simplified 0-1 value.
datasets.limitations: Not Hebrus Valles. Used as historical inspiration for the Storm Call (dust blocks sunlight, panels stop making power), not as local weather data.

datasets.name: DEV FALLBACK seasonal climate table
datasets.source: PLACEHOLDER. Hand-written to be Mars-plausible. NOT NASA data.
datasets.units: dust opacity 0-1 (game), temperature C, wind m/s
datasets.transformation: Sinusoid plus storm window plus deterministic noise.
datasets.limitations: MUST be replaced with values derived from a NASA Mars Global Climate Model product or rover (MEDA/REMS) data, and documented here. Until then it is a labelled development fallback. Episode 1 does NOT use this table: its storm timeline is a fixed scripted game model (src/core/episode.ts, episodeEnv).

datasets.name: DONKI solar flares, last 30 days (live, optional)
datasets.instrument: GOES X-ray flux (as catalogued in DONKI)
datasets.dateRange: rolling 30 days before the day you play
datasets.location: Sun / Earth orbit. NOT measured at Mars.
datasets.transformation: Fetched in the browser when online (CORS allowed, no key). The strongest flare of the window sets the storm's alert peak: X = STORM, M = HIGH, C or quieter = ELEVATED. Shown on the menu as LIVE with the fetch time; otherwise the game says ARCHIVED and uses donki-flr-2024-10-03.
datasets.limitations: Never blocks play. Prototype-quality real-time data per CCMC. The mapping to in-game risk is a game model.
datasets.verifiedHow: Queried 2026-11-01..14 from the command line: 8 flares, CORS header Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

datasets.name: Earth-Mars radio delay, 3 to 22 minutes one way
datasets.transformation: Quoted in dialogue; the 'Ask Earth' choice in the Storm Call answers only after the storm has hit (a dramatised delay, not a timed simulation).

datasets.name: Pits and channels of Hebrus Valles (HiRISE, PIA11704)
datasets.location: Hebrus Valles, Mars (about 20 N, 126 E; the exact base position is fictional)
datasets.transformation: Inspires the base's location and the candidate cave. Quoted size: about 1875 m long, 1125 m wide, nearly 500 m deep.
datasets.limitations: The outpost and its cave are fictional. Nobody has been inside the pit.

datasets.name: In-game NASA wiki links
datasets.transformation: Optional reading, opened only when the player chooses. Each page was loaded and checked on 2026-11-14.
datasets.limitations: External links need internet; the game itself does not.
